'''Goo''' was a colloquial term used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[IRD starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. It was a reference to a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], in which they preferred not to engage the enemy. The high-speed IRD starfighter was not very aerodynamic and lost considerable maneuverability in the atmosphere.
